newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $22 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Sept 9.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $22 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Sept 9.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $22 billion of three- and six-month bills on Sept 9 to pay down $6.50 billion as $28.502 billion of bills are maturing.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued Sept 12. The three-month bills mature December 12 and the six-month bills mature March 13, 1997.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127942B9 and for the six-month bills is 9127944B7.
